item.title: The Case for Newsrooms That Fit Inside a Single Document Request
item.description:
When a reader opens a newspaper dispatch on a commuter bus or a modest mobile data plan, they are asking a simple question: what happened, and why does it matter? They are not asking to download three megabytes of telemetry bundles, third-party ad auctions, and competing layout frameworks.

Modern publishing forgot a basic architectural truth of the early web. Text is fast. Well-structured markup with inlined styling arrives complete in the very first round trip.
